name: Warrior
flavor_text: A steadfast soldier who stands firm against any foe.

name: Knight
flavor_text: Clad in battered armor, this knight protects the innocent.

name: Scout
flavor_text: Quick on their feet, scouts uncover hidden paths and enemy movements.

name: Apprentice
flavor_text: A young spellcaster learning to control a flickering spark of magic.

name: Archer
flavor_text: A reliable marksman who rarely misses a stationary target.

name: Guard
flavor_text: The first line of defense, trained to hold the gates at all costs.

name: Acolyte
flavor_text: A humble devotee who channels a small measure of mystical energy.

name: Brawler
flavor_text: A rough fighter who relies on strength, grit, and a heavy fist.

name: Runner
flavor_text: Few can keep pace with this messenger across open terrain.

name: Initiate
flavor_text: An eager novice whose potential has only begun to awaken.

name: Swordsman
flavor_text: A disciplined blade wielder who has mastered the basics of combat.

name: Thief
flavor_text: A shadow in the night, always gone before the alarm sounds.

name: Vanguard
flavor_text: A hardened front-line fighter who inspires allies to advance.

name: Wind Dancer
flavor_text: Moving with the breeze, this agile warrior strikes from unexpected angles.

name: Storm Adept
flavor_text: Lightning crackles at their fingertips as their command of the storm grows.

name: Iron Sentinel
flavor_text: An unyielding guardian whose shield has survived a hundred battles.

name: Shadowblade
flavor_text: A silent assassin trained to end a fight before the enemy can react.

name: Runesmith
flavor_text: Ancient symbols glow across their gauntlets, empowering every strike.

name: Gladiator
flavor_text: A crowd favorite who turns every arena battle into a spectacle.

name: Tempest Runner
flavor_text: A swift combatant who rides the edge of a raging storm.

name: Achilles
flavor_text: The legendary Greek warrior charges into battle with unmatched courage, his fame echoing through the ages.

name: Atalanta
flavor_text: Swift as the hunt itself, Atalanta never loses sight of her quarry.

name: Morrigan
flavor_text: The phantom queen watches over battlefields, weaving fate through shadow and prophecy.

name: Leonidas
flavor_text: A fearless king who would rather fall standing than surrender an inch of ground.

name: Hermes
flavor_text: Divine messenger and trickster, Hermes crosses the world before a heartbeat passes.

name: Thor
flavor_text: The thunder god brings the fury of the storm down upon those who threaten the realms.

name: Amaterasu
flavor_text: Radiant sovereign of the sun, her divine light banishes darkness and restores the world.

name: Fenrir
flavor_text: The colossal wolf races toward destiny, destined to shake the foundations of the gods.

name: Zeus
flavor_text: King of Olympus, Zeus commands the heavens with a thunderbolt capable of shattering mountains and ending wars.

name: Odin
flavor_text: The All-Father sees through the veil of fate, wielding ancient wisdom and terrible power to defend the Nine Realms.
